aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.sectionTitle: Elevating the Power of Visual Effects
aboutPage.teamTitle: Meet the creative minds behind the lens
aboutPage.teamBody: Our team is made up of audiovisual professionals specialized in post-production who transform ideas into cinematic experiences.
aboutPage.pageDescription1: With the purpose of elevating, revitalizing and inspiring future generations in the Visual Effects market, Fenix Studios was born in 2022, acting in the post production market.
aboutPage.pageDescription2: We are defined by our team. We prioritize the collaboration of our members. Our success comes from a united team in a sustainable environment for the creative process. This is culture.
aboutPage.pageDescription3: We challenge ourselves to create visual effects on an international scale with a compact and specialized team using a modern pipeline workflow that enables us to adapt to the constant changes of a project and client demands.

homePage.title: Home
homePage.heroSubtitle: Specialists in Post-Production and VFX, we transform imagination into image and technology into emotion.
homePage.aboutBodyPost: to create visually excellent narratives. From concept to delivery, we seek the balance between technique and emotion. We believe every detail is an opportunity to enchant.
homePage.aboutCard1Body1: We handle every step of the process: Editing, VFX, Color Grading, Finishing and Delivery, focused on translating the creative vision of the project into its most refined form. Our goal is to unite storytelling and aesthetics to achieve maximum visual and emotional impact.
homePage.aboutCard1Body2: We transform images into experiences, ensuring narrative cohesion, visual fluidity and technical excellence.
homePage.aboutCard2Body1: We develop visual effects that balance art and technical precision, whether integrating high-complexity CG, subtle compositions or realistic simulations.
homePage.aboutCard2Body2: We bring the impossible to life. Every detail is designed to amplify the narrative's visual impact, combining realism, emotion and cinematic quality.
homePage.clientsTitle: Among the giants, our art finds its space
homePage.studySectionTitle: Master the Techniques That Shape the Future of Cinema
homePage.studyText: Explore the extraordinary world of visual effects with the courses made by Fenix Studios. Our academy is a meeting spot for creative minds that wish to master the most advanced VFX techniques. Involve yourself in the magic of digital creation through a practical and in-depth course. Our course will capacitate you to give life to your most ambitious creations. Join us and embark on a thrilling journey to become a specialist in visual effects.

postProductionCards.title: Color Grading
postProductionCards.text: Color grading with a cinematic approach and refined aesthetic direction. We shape light, color, and depth to create consistent, sophisticated, and emotionally striking imagery, respecting the visual identity of each production while elevating its narrative strength.

postProductionCards.title: Conform
postProductionCards.text: Conform carried out with technical precision and complete attention to narrative integrity. We organize, synchronize, and rebuild timelines with consistency and reliability, ensuring a seamless connection between editing, finishing, and delivery without compromising quality, pacing, or visual fidelity.

postProductionCards.title: Post-Production Coordination
postProductionCards.text: Post-production coordination focused on ensuring clarity, control, and alignment throughout every stage of the project. We manage schedules, teams, deliveries, and pipelines with organization and precision, connecting creative, technical, and operational processes to keep production efficient from start to finish.

postProductionCards.title: Lab & Data Management
postProductionCards.text: Lab and data management focused on security, organization, and operational continuity. We structure ingest, backup, verification, and media management workflows with technical precision, ensuring file integrity, traceability, and stability throughout every stage of post-production.

postProductionCards.title: Master & Delivery
postProductionCards.text: Master and delivery handled with technical rigor and uncompromising quality control. We finalize and distribute content across multiple formats and specifications, ensuring visual consistency, technical compliance, and reliability throughout every stage of delivery.

vfxCards.title: 3D
vfxCards.text: 3D production focused on film, advertising, and high-impact visual experiences. We develop environments, assets, and animations with refined technical execution, combining artistic direction, realism, and performance to deliver imagery that strengthens narratives, enhances brands, and expands the visual scale of every project.

vfxCards.title: Compositing
vfxCards.text: Compositing designed to merge technique with invisibility. We integrate 3D elements, visual effects, and live-action footage with precise control over light, texture, and depth, ensuring cohesive, natural, and visually solid imagery from the first frame to the last.

vfxCards.title: Supervision
vfxCards.text: Technical and creative supervision focused on ensuring visual consistency, operational efficiency, and complete control over every stage of production. We oversee processes, teams, and deliveries with strategic vision and technical precision, ensuring each project reaches its highest aesthetic and narrative potential.

vfxCards.title: Motion Graphics
vfxCards.text: Motion graphics designed to transform information, identity, and narrative into movement. We create animations with precise visual direction, refined pacing, and strong aesthetic impact, combining design and cinematic language to communicate ideas with clarity and personality.

vfxCards.title: Visualization
vfxCards.text: Visualization developed to anticipate aesthetics, composition, and visual language before final execution. We create clear and strategic visual previews that support creative decisions, technical alignment, and narrative development throughout the entire production process.

vfxPage.title: VFX
vfxPage.introBody1: We develop visual effects that combine technical precision and artistic direction: Motion Graphics, CG, Compositing, Visualization, Animation, Rigging, Concept Art, VFX Supervision and Coordination. We work in an integrated way across all stages of the process, ensuring aesthetic consistency, technical efficiency and creative alignment.
vfxPage.introBody2: Every frame is designed to amplify the narrative impact, delivering realism, emotion and cinematic quality to the work.

postProductionPage.title: Post Production
postProductionPage.introBody1: We offer complete and refined solutions in audiovisual post-production. Lab, Data Management, Conform, Online Editing, Client Services, Post-Production Coordination, Color Grading, Mastering, QC & Delivery. With close and continuous oversight, we ensure an agile and efficient workflow, always aligned with your creative needs.
postProductionPage.introBody2: We create experiences, ensuring narrative cohesion, visual fluidity and technical excellence.

testimonyList.author: Bernardo Teixeira Pereira
bio: Graduated in Animation & Visual Effects in San Francisco, California, Bernardo founded Fenix Studios, creating a distinctive working model within the industry. He has worked on major national and international film productions.

Bernardo created and executed unique visual effects for a variety of international films and series, including Black Widow, Terminator: Dark Fate, Bad Boys for Life, Free Guy, Army of the Dead, She-Hulk: Attorney at Law, Winning Time: The Rise of the Lakers Dynasty and Ms. Marvel.
In Brazil, he worked as a Visual Effects Supervisor, contributing to productions such as Tá Escrito, Minha Irmã e Eu, Meu Nome é Gal, A Paixão Segundo G.H., Férias Trocadas and Um Dia Cinco Estrelas.

testimonyList.author: Bernardo de Paula Douahy
bio: Bernardo de Paula Douahy is a VFX Producer and Film Producer working across cinema, advertising, and digital content, with a strong focus on post-production, pipeline integration, and visual effects operations. Graduated from FAPCOM, he has built his career by moving between multiple areas of audiovisual production, developing a broad understanding of narrative, technical workflows, and finishing processes.

During his time at Paris Filmes, he worked as a VFX Coordination Assistant on productions such as Meu Nome é Gal, Tá Escrito, Férias Trocadas, and Minha Irmã e Eu, supporting post-production workflows and technical coordination for Brazilian feature films. He later expanded into the advertising and digital market, working with social media and podcast production for YouTube at Agência Camucá, leading projects with figures such as Atilio Bari, Sérgio Stern, Ricardo Cavallini, and Amanda Paschoal.

He made his independent film debut with the documentary Mãos que Não se Alcançam, winner of Best Film at the Mostra Itapety de Cinema, where he worked as producer, executive producer, screenwriter, and interviewer. Currently, he works at Fenix Studios as a VFX Producer, operating across lab, conform, coordination, and art departments to ensure operational fluidity, communication, and consistency throughout the entire post-production pipeline.

testimonyList.author: Carolina Reichel
bio: Carolina Reichel has worked in the audiovisual industry for over 17 years, building a solid career in post-production, client services, and project coordination across advertising, film, and television. She began her career in traffic and post-production coordination support, developing an early understanding of operational workflows, pipeline organization, and production dynamics. At the same time, she closely followed film sets as a production assistant, expanding her connection to audiovisual language beyond the post-production environment.

During her first year working in advertising post-production, she contributed to the feature film 2 Coelhos, an experience that marked the beginning of a career connected to both the advertising market and Brazilian cinema. Over the years, she has worked with studios and production companies such as Black Maria, Cine, Trator Filmes, Jonathan Post, Paris Pós, and Paris Filmes, strengthening her expertise in post-production coordination and the relationship between creative, technical, and operational teams.

Throughout her career, she has collaborated with directors such as Afonso Poyart, Tico Vicente, Xico de Deus, Rogério Utimura, Caco Souza, Drico Mello, Rodrigo Moreira, Rafa Coutinho, Clovis Mello, Cris Vida, Ivan Abujanra, Alex Miranda, Halder Gomes, Hsu Chien, Luiz Fernando Carvalho, Bruno Barreto, Esmir Filho, João Wainer, Claudio Ellovitch, and Marcos Jorge. Each collaboration expanded her perspective on narrative, aesthetics, and production workflows, shaping a professional profile defined by organization, creative sensitivity, and the ability to lead complex projects with clarity and precision.

testimonyList.author: Marcos Mackza
bio: Marcos Mackza is a Motion Graphics Designer and Compositor with over 20 years of experience in post-production, working across advertising, live events, and Brazilian cinema. Throughout his career, he has taken on multiple roles within the post-production pipeline, building a broad understanding of visual direction, compositing, and motion-driven storytelling.

His work combines graphic language, technical precision, and aesthetic sensitivity to create visually striking pieces. Most recently, he was part of the team at Paris Filmes, working as a Motion Designer, Art Director, and Compositor on productions such as Homem com H, Tá Escrito, and Central de Inteligência Cearense. He is highly proficient in tools such as Adobe After Effects, Cinema 4D, Mocha Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Nuke.

testimonyList.author: Renan Lopes
bio: Renan Lopes is a Digital Compositor with 7 years of experience in the film and television industry, working on visual effects projects focused on CG integration, 2D/3D compositing, and image finishing. A specialist in Nuke, he has developed a technical approach centered on visual precision, operational efficiency, and agile problem-solving within complex VFX pipelines.

Throughout his career, he has contributed to productions such as Ripley, Abigail, and Back in Action, working on compositing and finishing processes for international film and streaming productions. His work combines technical expertise, refined visual integration, and clear communication between departments, helping deliver consistent results in high-end productions.

testimonyList.author: Andre Luiz dos Santos
bio: A professional with a background in Electro-Electronics from SENAI, he began his career working with POS terminal maintenance, though programming quickly became the true foundation of his professional path. His growth accelerated after joining a call center company as a Programmer Trainee, where he developed strong technical foundations and gained valuable experience solving real-world operational challenges in high-demand environments.

Over the years, he has worked across different companies and technology sectors, building practical experience in development, infrastructure, support, and operations. This trajectory shaped a versatile profile capable of moving seamlessly between technical and strategic responsibilities. During the pandemic, a major career shift led him into the audiovisual industry, where he began working with technology focused on post-production environments, operational support, and infrastructure for complex creative pipelines.

His generalist mindset became a rare advantage in an increasingly specialized industry. More than mastering isolated tools or functions, his work is defined by the ability to connect departments, anticipate problems, and sustain operations with stability, adaptability, and broad technical vision.

testimonyList.author: Rogério Faggione
bio: Rogério Faggione works as a VFX Compositor, combining experience in digital compositing, pipeline development, and technical workflows for visual effects productions. With a background that includes software development and 3D generalism, he has built a multidisciplinary profile that connects artistic language, technical thinking, and constant adaptation to emerging technologies within the audiovisual industry.

Specialized in workflows involving Nuke and Unreal Engine, he develops solutions focused on visual integration, process automation, and pipeline optimization, always pursuing efficiency without compromising creative quality. His experience spans compositing, CG, custom tools, and technical project structuring, providing a broad understanding of the different stages of post-production.

With a strong interest in art, technology, and visual experimentation, he maintains a creative approach driven by curiosity and the constant pursuit of new aesthetic and operational possibilities. Beyond the digital environment, he is also involved in traditional artistic practices such as photography, drawing, painting, and sculpture, expanding his visual perception and artistic sensitivity within the projects he contributes to.

His profile combines autonomy, collaboration, and technical commitment, consistently contributing to teams that require fluidity, organization, and problem-solving capabilities within complex VFX pipelines.
